out.title: Chief Delivery Officer Dr. Rajesh Gharpure resigns
out.summary: Dr. Rajesh Gharpure, Chief Delivery Officer and SMP, resigned for personal reasons effective close of business October 14, 2026; company states no material reason behind the resignation.

person.name: Dr. Rajesh Gharpure
person.bio: SMP and Chief Delivery Officer of Persistent Systems; resigned citing personal reasons; no further background provided in the filing.
